_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Nangdi Player {player_id} Tic Tac Toe-da ni. 
Nang-gi goal ni board-da three in a row (horizontally, vertically, amata diagonally) thok-lip-taba. 
Nang-gi turn-da, nang-gi square number (0-8) select-taba che-ena, nang-gi mark thok-lip-taba. 
Example, '[4]' nang-gi mark board-gi center cell-da thok-lip-taba. 
Player {player_id} oina, nang-gi '{symbol}' amata nong-gi '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: পীশিনখিবা খোঙথাং অদু অচুম্বা ফোর্মেতদুগী মতুং ইন্না নত্তে।
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} অসি ভেলিদ সেল অমা নত্তে। 0 অমসুং 8গী মরক্তা লৈবা তাই.
